comment: MRDC 2323 (Georgia Tech Invention Studio) real geometry. Derived from testcase/hub_real/layout.json which was traced from the GT MRDC architectural drawing at 9 pts/ft. Resolves [A1] in mosa_validate.mjs.

provenance.derivation: stageWidthPx = 96.6 ft * 9 pts/ft = 869.4 px; stageHeightPx = 88.6 ft * 9 pts/ft = 797.4 px

polygon_note: L-shaped floor plan. SE notch at x > 39.6 ft, y > 48.6 ft (right-angle simplification of original 9-ft diagonal notch per layout.json note).
notchBlockerNote: Phase 2d: structural wall filling the SE notch (the region the L-polygon excludes). Makes the ADA/egress/noise objective grids treat notch cells as blocked/attenuated the same way they treat any wall, so reported objectives describe the real L-room rather than the bounding box. Rect corner = polygon reflex vertex (40.99378881987578%, 54.85327313769752%), extended to the stage edge (100,100). subtype=wall + cat=wall + blocksMovement=true so sim_ada/_egress block it and sim_noise rasterizes it into the STC grid; no engine edit.
